title: Give page: choose a layout
question: Three layouts for the Give page, written for donors. Online giving will run through Stripe once the account is set up; until then the form shows what it will look like. Pick one, add a note to steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Photograph appeal
options.thesis: A wide glaze photograph opens the page, a centered appeal sits under it, and the giving form follows directly.
options.viewport: Full-width glaze photograph under the header; a centered headline and appeal; then the form: once or monthly, amounts, and the Give button.
options.risk: The photograph carries the opening; until real photos arrive it relies on the stoneware images.

options.label: Three ways
options.thesis: Give once, give monthly and sponsor a surgery stand side by side, each with one plain line and one action.
options.viewport: Title and lede at top; three columns divided by upright cobalt strokes like the values; each with a short line and a button.
options.risk: Clear but expected; the three columns weigh the same even if sponsoring a surgery matters most.

options.label: Form beside the case
options.thesis: The giving form sits in the first screen beside the reason to give, so a ready donor can give in seconds.
options.viewport: Left: headline, lede and the 501(c)(3) line. Right: the giving form in an inked frame. Below: what your gift pays for.
options.risk: It leads with the transaction; donors who need to trust the ministry first have to scroll for that.
